items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Please you go and talk to Iznaga and the rest of the

ctx.x: I see. Okay, I got, I got the jist of that. Okay, give the name, as far as you can remember, of the original Machito band. First of all, why did they call it Machito and the Afro-Cubans?

Well, you know, when I was born they called me Macho, not Machito, but this Cuban fellow, he say "Macho, it sound too harsh, too rude. Why don't we call Machito and y su Afro-Cubanos." When I get down there I say no, no, no. Please you go and talk to Iznaga and the rest of the
musicians, because this is a cooperative, I don't want that they think that I want to change the Siboney name, so we wasn't - there was no way out.
